rules.accepted_credit_types: Not pre-approved by BSRB; must relate to psychology practice (K.A.R. 102-1-15). Limits per renewal form: seminars/workshops 50, self-study 12 (40 with post-test), first-time presentations 15, publications 45, academic courses 50, supervision given/received 15 each, quality care 15, professional organizations 12, personal psychotherapy 20
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated by date of original licensure (renewal form: 50/33/17/0 hours by half-year of licensure); no CE during a temporary license.
rules.notes: Includes 3 h professional ethics plus diagnosis & treatment of mental disorders (FAQ: 3 h; current renewal form: 6 h). Extension up to 6 months if requested before expiration (K.A.R. 102-1-15(g)). Master's-level psychologists/LCP: also 50 h incl. 3 h ethics (K.A.R. 102-4-10a).
